title: Part 5 : 2019: Ceramic Tiles — Methods of Test, Sampling and Basis for Acceptance Part 5 Determination of Resistance to Thermal Shock ( Second Revision )
clause_1_scope: This standard (Part 5) covers a method of test for determining the resistance to thermal shock of all ceramic tiles in normal conditions of use. Depending on the water absorption of the tiles, different procedures (tests with or without immersion) are used unless there is an agreement to the contrary.
clause_3_terminology: Sampling and Basis for Acceptance Part 5 Determination of Resistance to Thermal Shock

marking_requirements: Each container, package or piece shall be marked indelibly with the manufacturer's name, brand/trademark, grade, batch number, and month/year of manufacture.
The product may also be marked with the Standard Mark (BIS Certification Mark) governed by the Bureau of Indian Standards Act.
